title: User Registration with Role Assignment
description: Verify that users can register successfully with valid credentials and are assigned the correct role (owner, mechanic, admin) with proper validation and error handling.

steps.description: Navigate to registration page
Fill registration form with valid details including selecting a role
Submit the registration form
Confirm user account is created and assigned the selected role
Verify welcome or onboarding page is shown based on role

title: Authentication and Redirect Based on Role
description: Check that registered users can login with correct credentials and are redirected to role-specific dashboards.

steps.description: Navigate to sign-in page
Enter valid email and password
Click sign-in
Verify login succeeds
Check user is redirected to a dashboard customized to the user role

title: Failed Login With Incorrect Credentials
description: Verify login failure occurs with incorrect email or password and appropriate error message is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to sign-in page
Input invalid or non-existing email and/or incorrect password
Click sign-in button
Confirm login fails
Check proper error message is displayed to user

title: Add Vessel with Complete Details and QR Code Generation
description: Verify that vessel owners can add a vessel with required details, upload photos, and receive a unique QR code linking correctly to the vessel record.

steps.description: Login as vessel owner
Navigate to vessel onboarding component
Enter all mandatory fields for vessel details
Upload vessel photos
Submit vessel registration
Verify vessel record is created in system
Check that a unique QR code is generated and displayed

title: Verify Equipment Manifest with All Categories and Service Interval Tracking
description: Ensure the equipment manifest supports all 15 categories with capability to add service intervals, warranty information, condition monitoring, and photo uploads for equipment.

steps.description: Login as vessel owner
Navigate to equipment manifest section for a vessel
Add equipment items covering all 15 categories with detailed info
Attach service intervals and warranty data
Upload equipment photos
Verify all equipment entries are saved accurately
Check service interval reminders or conditions are tracked correctly

title: Mechanic Scans QR Code and Requests Vessel Access
description: Validate that a mechanic can scan vessel QR code through the web scanner, identify vessel correctly, and send an access request to the owner with notification generated.

steps.description: Login as mechanic
Open QR scanner and scan a valid vessel QR code
Verify vessel details are displayed after scan
Send access request for the vessel
Confirm access request notification is sent to vessel owner

title: Vessel Owner Approves or Denies Mechanic Access Request
description: Ensure vessel owners can view access requests from mechanics, approve or deny them, and access permissions are granted or revoked accordingly.

steps.description: Login as vessel owner with pending access requests
View details of access request from mechanic
Approve the access request
Check that mechanic receives confirmation and access permission
Deny an access request
Verify mechanic is notified of denial and access is not granted

title: Full Work Order Lifecycle: Request to Completion
description: Test entire work order lifecycle including owner submitting request, mechanic quoting, owner approval, in-progress updates with parts and photos, and work completion with rating.

steps.description: Owner submits a detailed work order request
Mechanic reviews and submits a quote including labor and parts estimate
Owner receives notification and reviews quote
Owner approves the quote
Mechanic updates work order status as in-progress with photos and parts added
Verify all updates are saved and displayed properly
Mechanic marks work order as complete
Both owner and mechanic submit ratings with comments
Check both ratings are recorded and reflected in profiles

title: Quote Submission with Revision Workflow and Notifications
description: Verify mechanics can submit quotes with detailed breakdowns, send revisions after negotiation, and the owner receives notifications of each update.

steps.description: Mechanic creates initial quote for work order
Send quote to owner
Owner receives notification of new quote
Mechanic submits revised quote with changes
Owner receives notification of revised quote
Owner accepts final quote
Quote status updates accordingly

title: Parts Database Autocomplete and Per-Work-Order Parts Logging
description: Confirm that the parts database autocomplete provides relevant suggestions as mechanic types, and parts used are logged on specific work orders with metadata and photos.

steps.description: Mechanic starts entering part name in parts entry field on work order
Autocomplete suggestions appear based on input
Select part from suggestions or enter new part
Add metadata such as quantity and cost
Optionally upload photo of part
Save parts used for work order
Parts are recorded correctly under the work order

title: Bidirectional Rating System Post Work Order Completion
description: Check that upon work order completion, owners and mechanics can submit ratings and comments for each other and the aggregated ratings update mechanic and owner profiles.

steps.description: After work order completion, owner accesses rating form for mechanic
Owner submits rating with comments
Mechanic accesses rating form for owner
Mechanic submits rating with comments
Confirm both ratings are stored in the system
Verify aggregated ratings on profile pages reflect new reviews

title: Mechanic Directory Search and Filtering
description: Verify that users can search and filter marine mechanics by certifications, availability, rating, and location accurately and that results update dynamically.

steps.description: Navigate to mechanic directory page
Enter search terms and apply multiple filters including certification, availability, rating, and location
Search results update dynamically matching filters
Mechanic cards show correct metadata and status

title: Preferred Mechanics List Management
description: Validate that boat owners can add or remove mechanics to their preferred list, add private notes, and that the list is persisted correctly.

steps.description: Login as boat owner
Navigate to preferred mechanics management
Add a mechanic to preferred list with optional private note
Preferred mechanic is listed correctly
Remove mechanic from preferred list
Mechanic is removed and no longer listed

title: Messaging Between Owner and Mechanic Contextual to Vessel and Work Order
description: Ensure real-time direct messaging is delivered correctly between owners and mechanics with context of vessel and associated work orders including notifications.

steps.description: Login as owner and mechanic respectively
Initiate messaging regarding a specific vessel and/or work order
Send messages back and forth
Messages appear in real-time in both sender and receiver views
Notification alerts trigger upon new messages

title: Notifications for Access Requests, Work Orders, Quotes, Messaging, and Ratings
description: Verify the in-app notification system generates alerts for various event types, displays them correctly, and supports marking as read.

steps.description: Trigger events: access request sent, work order updated, quote submitted, message received, rating completed
Corresponding notifications appear in app notification feed
Mark notifications as read
Read notifications are visually distinct and can be filtered

title: Admin Announcement CRUD with Role Targeting, Pinning and Expiration
description: Verify admins can create, update, delete announcements targeted at specific user roles with the ability to pin announcements and set expiration dates.

steps.description: Login as admin
Create announcement with title, content, role targeting, pinning option, and expiration date
Announcement appears in role-targeted feeds and pinned announcements section
Update announcement content and settings
Changes are reflected correctly
Delete announcement
Announcement is removed from feeds

title: Help Center Role-Filtered Documentation and Markdown Rendering
description: Ensure help center displays relevant guides filtered by user role and renders markdown content correctly for readability and formatting.

steps.description: Login as different user roles
Navigate to help center
Displayed help articles correspond to user role
Markdown content renders accurately with headings, lists, links, and code blocks

title: Admin Control Panel User and Settings Management
description: Test full CRUD operations on users, app settings, announcements, and help content in the admin control panel with role-based access checks.

steps.description: Login as admin
Create, update, and delete user accounts
Changes are reflected immediately across the system
Modify application-wide settings and save
Settings changes persist and affect relevant features
Manage help content and announcements CRUD
Validate role-based access prevents unauthorized operations

title: Role-Adaptive Landing Page Content Display
description: Verify that upon login, the landing page dynamically shows relevant stats, quick actions, feeds, and navigation elements appropriate to the logged-in user's role.

steps.description: Login as owner
Landing page shows owner-specific content and statistics
Logout and login as mechanic
Landing page updates to mechanic-specific content and features
Logout and login as admin
Landing page displays admin dashboard and controls

title: Dark/Light Mode Toggle and Theme Consistency
description: Verify that the theme toggle correctly switches between dark and light modes and that the UI components maintain visual consistency with glassmorphism styling across all pages.

steps.description: Login to application
Toggle theme from light mode to dark mode
UI updates to dark mode with glassmorphism effects properly rendered
Toggle back to light mode
UI returns to light mode with consistent styling

title: Service History and Scheduled Maintenance Reminders
description: Validate the service history viewer displays accurate past maintenance records for vessels and equipment, and scheduled reminders appear when service intervals approach.

steps.description: Login as owner
Navigate to service history viewer
Verify all recorded service events are listed with proper details
Check scheduled maintenance reminders trigger based on interval thresholds
Reminders display notifications or alerts in the UI
